name: VaultBorn Treaty Escrow
description: Compensation escrow for a treaty or protectorate: an arbiter can only pay the named recipient or return the money to the payer, and the payer can take it back alone after the expiry time.

resources.name: VaultBorn
resources.description: The strategy game whose treaties and protectorates this escrow settles, with the reproduction steps for this template.

payer.name: Payer
payer.description: The kingdom that locks the compensation, for example the guardian of a protectorate.

recipient.name: Recipient
recipient.description: The kingdom that is paid if the arbiter releases the escrow.

arbiter.name: Arbiter
arbiter.description: Decides between the two fixed outcomes. It can never send the money anywhere else.

openEscrow.name: Open escrow
openEscrow.description: Lock the compensation for a treaty. All three parties join before the payer funds it.

payer.name: Lock the compensation
payer.description: Name the treaty, the amount, the expiry time and your return address, then fund the escrow.

recipient.name: Name your payout address
recipient.description: Provide the address that is paid if the arbiter releases the escrow.

arbiter.name: Accept the arbiter seat
arbiter.description: Add the key that will sign the outcome.

releaseEscrow.name: Release to recipient
releaseEscrow.description: The arbiter pays the compensation to the named recipient.

returnEscrow.name: Return to payer
returnEscrow.description: The arbiter returns the compensation to the payer.

reclaimEscrow.name: Reclaim after expiry
reclaimEscrow.description: The payer takes the compensation back without the arbiter once the expiry time has passed.

openEscrowTransaction.name: Escrow opened
openEscrowTransaction.description: $(<principalSatoshis>) satoshis were locked for the treaty.

releaseTransaction.name: Escrow released
releaseTransaction.description: The arbiter paid the compensation to the recipient.

returnTransaction.name: Escrow returned
returnTransaction.description: The arbiter returned the compensation to the payer.

reclaimTransaction.name: Escrow reclaimed
reclaimTransaction.description: The payer took the compensation back after the expiry time.

releaseInput.name: Escrow
releaseInput.description: The escrow, spent by the arbiter in favour of the recipient.

returnInput.name: Escrow
returnInput.description: The escrow, spent by the arbiter in favour of the payer.

reclaimInput.name: Escrow
reclaimInput.description: The escrow, spent by the payer after the expiry time.

recipientPayoutOutput.name: Compensation paid
recipientPayoutOutput.description: The compensation, less the fixed network fee, paid to the recipient.

payerPayoutOutput.name: Compensation returned
payerPayoutOutput.description: The compensation, less the fixed network fee, returned to the payer.

escrowLockingScript.name: Treaty escrow
escrowLockingScript.description: Pays the named recipient or returns to the payer on the arbiter's signature, and returns to the payer alone after the expiry time.

scripts.escrowRedeemScript: <treatyIdentifier> OP_DROP OP_IF OP_IF <recipientLockingScript> OP_ELSE <payerLockingScript> OP_ENDIF OP_SWAP <arbiterKey.public_key> OP_CHECKSIGVERIFY OP_ELSE <expiryTime> OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY OP_DROP <payerKey.public_key> OP_CHECKSIGVERIFY <payerLockingScript> OP_ENDIF OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_TXINPUTCOUNT OP_1 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE <600> OP_SUB OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL

settlementFeeSatoshis.name: Settlement fee
settlementFeeSatoshis.description: Fixed number of satoshis the escrow leaves for the network fee when it is settled.

payerKey.name: Payer key
payerKey.description: The private key the payer uses to reclaim after the expiry time.

arbiterKey.name: Arbiter key
arbiterKey.description: The private key the arbiter uses to sign the outcome.

treatyIdentifier.name: Treaty identifier
treatyIdentifier.description: Sixteen bytes that name the treaty or protectorate this escrow belongs to.

principalSatoshis.name: Compensation
principalSatoshis.description: The amount locked in the escrow. Use at least 2000 satoshis so the payout stays above the dust limit.

expiryTime.name: Expiry time
expiryTime.description: Unix time in seconds after which the payer can reclaim without the arbiter.

payerLockingScript.name: Payer return address
payerLockingScript.description: The locking script that receives a return or a reclaim.

recipientLockingScript.name: Recipient payout address
recipientLockingScript.description: The locking script that receives a release.
